title: Bandit Elimination Contract
description: The road south to Millbrook has lost three wagons this month to a camp working out of the tree line, and the grain factors who use that road pooled coin to put a proper end to it - not a toll, not a truce, an end. Vorn wants the captain's head and the gang scattered; the merchants are paying by the head, and he told them plainly that means blood, not negotiation. The captain's purse holds more than a road crew earns in a season, all of it new-struck and none of it Dalhurst mint, and nobody left in the camp can say who hired them in the first place. Vorn does not ask twice about it - the contract's closed, the fee's paid, and the coin is yours to keep.

objectives.description: Find where the gang's been working the Millbrook road from
Break the gang holding the south road
Kill the captain the merchants paid to be rid of
Report to Vorn that the south road is clear

notes: Threat: grain factors losing wagons on the Millbrook road. Giver motive: paid by the head, Vorn wants results, not diplomacy. Consequence: refusing costs the factors their route - stated in prose, not wired. Soulstone undercurrent touchpoint (quest_web.md #6): the captain's purse is new-struck coin, none of it Dalhurst mint, and nobody in the camp can say who hired them - never named as a pattern, Vorn shrugs it off since the contract is closed and paid. Known duplicate pair with adventurers_04_bandit_contract (same giver, same 'eliminate a bandit camp' shape) - deliberately differentiated: adventurers_04 is the eastern outpost hired by 'the merchants' collectively with a written word ('eliminate') Vorn wants interpreted; this is the south road camp hired by named grain factors who want blood, not nuance, and it is the file carrying the soulstone touchpoint.
